title: Module 6 Quiz
description: Test your understanding of while loops, counters, accumulators, break, and infinite-loop prevention across all lessons in Module 6.

questions.prompt_text: What is the main purpose of Module 6: Indefinite Iteration?
options_json: To repeat instructions while a condition remains true and stop safely when the task is complete
To replace Python with another language
To remove the need for practice
questions.explanation: This module focuses on how to repeat instructions while a condition remains true and stop safely when the task is complete.

content.hint: Fill in the missing Python syntax.

questions.explanation: while starts an indefinite loop controlled by a condition.

content.bug_description: count is never updated inside the loop

questions.correct_answer: count is never updated inside the loop

questions.prompt_text: Arrange the lines to print 1 to 3 safely.
questions.explanation: The lines must be ordered so values are prepared before they are used.

questions.prompt_text: Which statement best describes a while loop?
options_json: It repeats while its condition is True
questions.explanation: A while loop continues as long as its condition evaluates to True.

content.hint: Fill in the missing Python syntax.

questions.prompt_text:
What is the output?
count = 1
while count <= 2:
    print(count)
    count += 1

questions.correct_answer: The loop body must be indented
questions.explanation: The print and update lines should be inside the while block.
